## Hello! 👋
  
I'm an **Economist** and **political scientist** with 8+ years of experience implementing statistical tools for analysis and decision-making in NGOs, public and private sectors. Currently pursuing MSc in Development Economics at University of Göttingen with DAAD EPOS scholarship.

My approach combines quantitative analysis (R, Python, QGIS) with participatory fieldwork to create data-driven solutions for territorial development.

---

## What I Do

**🔍 Data Analysis & Geospatial Analysis**
- Statistical analysis and econometric modeling
- Interactive dashboards and visualization (R, Shiny)
- Territorial analysis and mapping (QGIS, Google Earth Engine)

**🤝 Participatory Methodologies**
- Community engagement and workshop facilitation
- Co-creation methodologies for rural development
- Multi-stakeholder coordination processes

**📊 Research & Policy**
- Survey design and analysis
- Public policy evaluation and design
- Academic research in development economics

---

## Featured Projects

### Rural Scholarship Allocation Tool
*Interra Foundation (Colombia) | 2023-2024*

Interactive Shiny application optimizing scholarship distribution for 500+ rural youth using multi-criteria algorithms.

[**View Application →**](https://jovenesrurales.shinyapps.io/Visor/){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

### National Strategy for Coastal Municipalities
*National Planning Department (Colombia) | 2020-2023*

Coordinated the design and drafting of a public policy document for 47 coastal municipalities through regional workshops and quantitative analysis

[**View Policy Document →**](https://portalterritorial.dnp.gov.co/AdmCPBioceanica/iCosterosMunicipios?idSelect=4){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

### Local Leaders Identification System
*Research Project | 2017-2020*

Applied network analysis methodology (Godfather Index) to identify community leaders and analyze coordination dynamics, impacting youth across 7 municipalities.

[**Read Thesis →**](http://hdl.handle.net/1992/43811){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
